# 007 · INT8 post-training quantization of MobileCLIP2-B and S0 on the S22

## Conclusions
- **Failed run, kept for the record.** All 8 AI Hub quantize jobs (B and S0 × w8a8/w8a16 × image/text) **succeeded**.
  But AI Hub delivers the quantized model as a `.zip` (`job_<id>_qdq_onnx/model.onnx` + `model.data`), and the script
  expected a bare `.onnx`. Every encoder errored before compile, so no device or quantized-accuracy numbers exist.
  The auto block above says "ok" and shows only the fp32 combinations because this version of the script didn't
  fail the run when nothing completed.
- Fix (commit `f29ec23`): extract the zip; cache quantize jobs by (float ONNX SHA-256, precision, calibration
  dataset) so they're reused instead of re-run; raise an error when no encoder completes.
- The 8 quantize job IDs above were seeded into `.cache/aihub_quantize_jobs.json` and reused by experiment 008.
